title: AgentHeadByRefResponse
description: Response of GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}?environment=<SessionEnvironment>: the promotion head generation of the agent the Backend-issued `agent_ref` stands for, in the caller's tenant and project. Closed: it carries the ref, the closed environment, the generation and whether the agent was ever promoted there; never a raw agent id, name, best-config id or run id. `generation` is 0 and `exists` is false when the agent has never been promoted in that environment. A foreign, unknown or malformed ref is refused with `reference_not_found` (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) and nothing of the request is echoed.

agent_ref.description: The ref that was asked about, returned unchanged (it is a Backend-issued opaque value the caller already holds).

generation.description: Current head generation; the value a client sends back as X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation when it publishes the winner. JSON-safe integer bound.

exists.description: True when a head row exists for the agent and environment (the agent was promoted at least once); false means generation 0 and no promotion yet.
